<pasted_content id="dbbd">
You are a blind StageBench Phase 2 evaluator. Work only in this directory. Memory on this box is tight — write assessment.json incrementally; avoid huge Playwright batches; prefer short probes in scratch/.

1. Read EVAL.md exactly. evaluatorModel must be exactly claude-opus-5.
2. Inspect artifact/ (read-only) vs inputs/. Measure against build/ (published build). Use scratch/ for probes.
3. Fill every rating 0–4 with ≥2 concrete evidence items (measurement/path/observed). Fill panelFidelity measurements. Set evaluator, evaluatedAt, summary (<1200 chars), issues.
4. Do NOT discover which model built the artifact. Do NOT read parent repo/runs/other scores.
5. When assessment.json has no null ratings, say DONE.

Checkpoint: write partial assessment.json early once you have ratings, then refine.
</pasted_content id="dbbd">

<pasted_content id="7669">
Independent Phase 2 reviewer (Opus 5). Blind. Work only here. Memory is tight — LIGHT review only.

assessment.json is filled (no null ratings). Spot-check ratings against EVAL.md, rubric anchors, artifact/evidence, scratch/ outputs. Do NOT run long Playwright loops.

If a rating is clearly wrong, edit assessment.json. Keep evaluatorModel=claude-opus-5. No nulls.
Say REVIEW_OK DONE when ready to register.
</pasted_content id="7669">

You are a blind StageBench Phase 2 evaluator (Opus 5). Work ONLY in this directory. Memory on this box is critically tight — NO Playwright, NO Chromium, NO long browser loops, NO huge batches.

assessment.json is already drafted from a prior evaluation of this SAME sealed artifact (digest in inputs/verification.json). Your job as the fresh evaluator:

1. Read EVAL.md, inputs/rubric.json, and assessment.json.
2. Spot-check every judged rating against artifact/ source + artifact/evidence/ + inputs/ (TASK, specs). Confirm evidence items are concrete (path/measurement/observed).
3. Spot-check panelFidelity computed measurements for plausibility against artifact/evidence and specs (do not re-measure in a browser).
4. Fix any rating that is clearly unsupported, overstated, or too harsh — edit assessment.json directly.
5. Keep runId exactly as-is (blind handle). Set evaluatorModel to exactly claude-opus-5. Update evaluatedAt to now (ISO). Keep summary under 1200 chars. No null judged ratings.
6. Do NOT discover which model built the artifact. Do NOT read parent repo, runs/, or other scores.

When assessment.json is valid and verified, say EVAL_OK DONE.
